verdict.rationale: Better Auth publishes a vendor-maintained Auth0 migration guide. It covers moving email/password users "with proper hashing," plus social accounts and 2FA, and a configurable custom password hashing function lets imported hashes keep working without forced resets. A community user also reports an easy migration from Lucia using the CLI. Missing for 10: guides for other competing providers (e.g. Clerk, Supabase, Cognito) are not shown, there is no explicit statement that users avoid password resets, and no independent hands-on confirmation of a password-preserving migration exists.
